noMotionDesc: Bring each clip in and out, and move the recording in between.
noRoom: No free space at the playhead.
customHint: Custom start and end replace Amount.
desc_tiltIn: Swings in from a 3D tilt and settles flat. The classic launch-video opener.
desc_rise: Floats up from below while fading in. Calm and clean.
desc_zoomIn: Starts close and pulls back into place.
desc_fadeIn: Fades in from the background. The quietest way to start.
desc_slowPush: A slow, steady push in. Keeps a still screen feeling alive.
desc_orbit: Gently sways in 3D, back and forth. Good for loops.
desc_tiltAway: Tilts back and falls away. The classic ending.
desc_pose_from: How the recording looks as this move starts.
desc_pose_to: How the recording looks as this move ends.
desc_swap: Plays this move in reverse: its end becomes its start.
desc_editing: Drag to adjust. The preview follows as you go.
desc_lift: Fades in while settling up a few pixels. Barely there.
desc_swingIn: Swings in from the side like a door opening.
desc_unfold: Starts lying back, then stands up to face you.
desc_dropIn: Drops in from above and settles.
desc_breathe: A slow, gentle swell in and out. Keeps a still screen alive.
desc_drift: A slow sideways drift, like a camera on a slider.
desc_slowPull: A slow, steady pull back to reveal more around it.
desc_panTilt: Slowly turns in 3D for a sense of depth.
desc_liftAway: Fades out while rising a few pixels. Barely there.
desc_swingOut: Swings away to the side like a door closing.
desc_growIn: Grows into place from a little smaller.
desc_slideUpIn: Slides up into place from below.
desc_slideDownIn: Slides down into place from above.
